Text-to-speech with explicit MP3 response format

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.createSpeechRequestFromJson("{\"input\":\"The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.\",\"model\":\"tts-1-hd\",\"response_format\":\"mp3\",\"speed\":1.0,\"voice\":\"nova\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.speech(_req)
print(result)
```
